Execution brief: #1179 remaining code work — settlement-currency defect chain (D1–D4) + feed-death observability. Non-closing reference: issue 1179. Never write close/fix/resolve before an issue number in any body text — including negations ("Does not close #N" auto-closed the issue twice); write "Part of #1179" only.

Context. The 2026-07-10 v0.1.11 supervised session proved the SBE and trader-abort fixes live and made one winning trade — then settlement booking failed at 12:10:00 with settlement_input_invalid: "settlement input missing configured settlement currency" and the strategy parked permanently (zero entry evaluations afterward). Root chain is code-anchored at c1dd3246c in the #1179 ledger (comment 4873354436, v0.1.11 session entry). What remains to close #1179 is: this fix chain, then owner-run session two (adverse run + cash reconciliation — not your scope).

Work items, in order:

1. D1 — config unblock: the supervised profile declares no risk.capital_pools, and settlement currency derives exclusively from a venue+account pool match (bolt_v3_archetypes/binary_oracle_edge_taker.rs::settlement_currency_for_execution_account). Add a non-enforcing pool declaration (enforce_submit_admission = false — schema already supports it) to the supervised profile so settlement can derive its currency without activating admission enforcement. The declared supervised mode semantics must not change.
2. D2 — load-time validator: there are zero settlement-currency references in bolt_v3_validate* — a config that structurally cannot settle passes verify-live-config and fails only at booking time, live. Add validation: any config that can open a settleable position must be able to derive its settlement currency at load. Same class as #1238 F-1: build ONE owning predicate consumed by both the build path and the validator — do not re-derive the condition in the validator. Differential test required: current supervised profile shape (pre-D1) must fail load; post-D1 shape passes.
3. D3 — design proposal BEFORE code (owner reviews the design first): a settlement booking error inserts into settlement_booking_error_keys, which the booking path treats as terminal poison (guards at mod.rs 947/1070/1217) with no lifecycle transition on the live path — one failure of any cause parks a single-exposure strategy forever (#1276 fixed only the restart path; session-one finding (b) was the same outcome via a different cause). Propose the terminal-state design: how a booking failure resolves (retry-with-evidence, operator-visible parked state with release, or terminal transition), fail-loud, no time-based gates. Post the proposal on the PR/issue and wait for owner review before implementing.
4. D4 — logging storm: ~40k journald lines/min from three per-quote-tick full-field warn! sites (mod.rs 3710/3724/3801/3983) plus NT orderbook out-of-order WARNs → journald suppressed 5k–54k messages/30s, making mid-session journalctl blind. Fix: state-change-keyed logging (log on transition, not per tick) + an NT component-level filter for the venue-quirk WARNs. No information loss on transitions; evidence records unchanged.
5. Feed-death observability (acceptance-bar item 5 residual, session-one finding (a)): a mid-run reference-feed death and its recovery are transport-silent at every layer. Wire disconnect/reconnect observability for the reference feed (event-driven, loud, with reason), feeding the existing operator-health surface from #1229. If this is better staged as its own PR after D1–D4, say so rather than bundling.

Rules that bind this work: each PR body says "Part of #1179" (nothing else referencing the number); no manual full-CI dispatches — local gates + exact-head debug lane, the merge queue is the gate; every new public surface must name its production caller in the PR body; no venue/strategy policy outside its owning layer; differential tests must fail on pre-fix code (state the red-run evidence). Reviewer (Claude) runs the suite at your exact head — report the head SHA you verified at with each push.

I’ll implement the code-ready slice in the declared order, stop D3 at a written design proposal for owner review, and keep all issue references to the exact phrase `Part of #1179`. I’m using the repository planning/verification skills because this is multi-step production behavior work with a mandatory design gate.
